title: OpenDev + PTG 2020 Sponsors
description: Historical sponsorship prospectus and sponsor acknowledgments for the planned June 8–11, 2020 OpenDev + PTG event in Vancouver.
archiveNotice: Historical archive — OpenDev + PTG, Vancouver, June 8–11, 2020. Sponsorship agreements and purchases for this event are closed. The original prospectus retains historical prices, offers and contact details; these are not current opportunities.
body:
OpenDev 2020 event archive

Historical Sponsorship Prospectus

The original prospectus describes sponsorship levels and add-ons for the planned OpenDev + PTG event in Vancouver in June 2020.

View the 2020 Sponsorship Prospectus (PDF, 9 pages)

Sponsorship closed

The former process asked sponsors to review the prospectus, sign a Master Event Sponsorship Agreement and sign an OpenDev + PTG Sponsorship Agreement. These historical signing and purchase actions are closed and are not available from this archive.

Thank you to the sponsors acknowledged on the published event page.
